must_identify.item: The new api pods exit because the name redis does not resolve
must_identify.evidence: Container logs show five consecutive failed attempts to resolve the `redis` hostname (`[Errno -2] Name does not resolve`), after which the application gave up and exited with code 1, triggering the restart loop [6, 7].

must_identify.item: The cause is the pod's dnsPolicy None / dnsConfig search domains (cluster.internal), not REDIS_HOST, the redis Service or CoreDNS
must_identify.evidence: The revision 2 pod template introduced `dnsPolicy: None` with an explicit `dnsConfig.searches` list using the domain suffix `cluster.internal` [8], whereas the cluster's actual CoreDNS zone is `cluster.local`, as declared in the `coredns` ConfigMap's Corefile (`kubernetes cluster.local in-addr.arpa ip6.arpa`) [11].

notes: The RCA gives no explicit remediation, so fix_acceptable is null. It explicitly rules out the redis Service. It does not explicitly rule out REDIS_HOST or CoreDNS, though it attributes the fault squarely to the dnsConfig change.
